name: Künstlerin Begründungsreif
personality: Has completed the work and is still accepting explanations of why it matters.
visual_intent: Banana Taped to Wall Artist translated handheld prop: tall hooked ink pear,small berry artist beret,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE small rectangular grey display BOARD with ONE clay yellow banana fixed by ONE silver tape strip,carried at flank,not real wall/scene. Ecstatic crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow high
biography: Has completed the work and is still accepting explanations of why it matters. Her HyperNorm board offers an object already surrounded by explanations. A dissonant card asks whether looking first is still permitted. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Werk ist fertig. Seine Begründung wird weiter entgegengenommen.

name: Kritiker Kennerspur
personality: Can recognize importance before the object has had a chance to interfere.
visual_intent: Art Critic with Monocle: broad low square ink splat,small dark plum formal cap,tiny cream cravat,ONE brass MONOCLE held BELOW face on short cord and tiny closed catalogue. Heavy unequal skeptical eyes,closed huge toothless disdainful pout,no lens hiding eye
biography: Can recognize importance before the object has had a chance to interfere. His HyperNorm monocle recognizes importance before the catalogue introduces the object. A dissonant card asks what he actually saw before knowing what to say. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bedeutung wurde vor dem Sichtkontakt fachgerecht erkannt.

name: Wachwart Ruhebestand
personality: Keeps an eye on everything and would like permission to decide which eye.
visual_intent: Museum Guard Sleeping adapted UPRIGHT: round top-heavy ink blob,small teal guard cap,tiny cream collar,ONE old brass keyring and closed visitor counter device at flank. One eye almost shut OTHER WHITE/RED/BLACK eye drowsily open,mouth small toothless tilted oval,not lying/no chair scene
biography: Keeps an eye on everything and would like permission to decide which eye. His HyperNorm counter records the visitors passing through an approved silence. A dissonant card asks whether a tired guard is part of the collection too. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Aufsicht erfolgt wechselweise mit dem verfügbaren Auge.

name: Malerin Fleckwirkung
personality: Insists the accident was intentional once everybody has admired it.
visual_intent: Splatter Painter: squat broad asymmetrical ink splat,little rust paint-spotted headscarf,two lashes,tiny canvas apron patch,ONE thick brush loaded teal and small palette with THREE big colored daubs. Huge joyful crooked open grin with THREE upper teeth,no splatters across neighbours/background
biography: Insists the accident was intentional once everybody has admired it. Her HyperNorm palette makes each accident available for retrospective intention. A dissonant card enjoys a mark she had planned to hide. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Absicht wird nach Würdigung des Flecks festgelegt.

name: Skulptor Eigenform
personality: Has become the exhibit and still objects to the lighting.
visual_intent: Modern Sculpture Blob: tall broad-based dark INK blob with exaggerated but ROUNDED asymmetric top-lobes,small copper ring ornament around one lobe ABOVE eyes,tiny cream collar,ONE little abstract brass bent-loop sculpture held on palm,no pedestal or white stone body. Unequal heavy lids,closed toothless crooked dry smirk
biography: Has become the exhibit and still objects to the lighting. His HyperNorm loop sculpture insists the room is framing him incorrectly. A dissonant card asks whether being unfinished might be a useful form. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Eigenform beanstandet weiterhin die äußeren Bedingungen.

name: Shopwart Andenklich
personality: Can offer a portable version of the experience nobody has yet agreed happened.
visual_intent: Gift Shop Hawker: broad round lopsided ink splat,little plum retail cap,tiny teal collar,ONE miniature tote bag printed only plain banana SILHOUETTE and TWO little blank postcard souvenirs in other hand. Huge unequal eager worried eyes,closed nervous toothless zigzag smile,no shop scene/text
biography: Can offer a portable version of the experience nobody has yet agreed happened. His HyperNorm tote promises a portable version of an unsettled experience. A dissonant card asks whether a memory must fit the souvenir. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Erlebnis ist in zwei handlichen Ausführungen erhältlich.
